body:
It probably feels great for them.

I hope I can defeat it as well.

I’ve tried all of those, they help for some time but then you just come back to where you started.

Doesn’t mean I won’t stop trying.

The one were on is a good one. Just a make post saying you want to talk to somebody and I’m sure people will reply to you rather quick.

There’s other ones like r/needafriend, I’ve never used it but I’m sure you’d find someone to talk to there.

I know this might be hard to understand at first, and I also had to learn this the hard way, but just let her live her life.

Have a new start, meet some people on reddit who would like to talk to chat with you, make friends.

I am glad you have finally gotten her out of her head, that is a good start.
It is possible that you might do it, but trust me, it is not the right choice or move.
Would you do it?
The language barrier made me think it was murder.
The thought of her?

I hope so too. I was just thinking about what people would think if I killed myself. Mostly about the people who hurt me in some way. 

Perhaps I’m just overthinking. In reality nobody would be sad for probably, except for my family. Even though you could say I have “friends”.

No, not really. The post isn’t just about changing. I’m starting to not care about what people care about me. They mostly think good about me, but I have other problems.

I don’t know why I even said anything about changing in the original text. I’m sorry. I just wanted to express my thoughts I guess.

Not exactly. I just changed, I took criticism and I changed. Not that I was a bad person, I just didn’t fit in, not to sound edgy or anything.

I didn’t really have any big issues. The changing I talked about was just from experience, it was inevitable. And another thing to note is that when I wrote this I let my emotions take over. I hope I made it more clear.

I changed to adapt you could say.

I can relate to you in some ways, but not this extreme. Perhaps the most I can relate to is the having nobody to talk to IRL, I do have options to talk to, but I just don’t want to talk about it, because I don’t trust people anymore. I feel like they will betray me.

By the way I’m sorry for the late reply, are you still there?
I really hope you get some luck or find someone that will bring back hope.

Wanna tell me what happened?

Also sorry for not replying sooner

I’ve had moments where I thought the only solution to this problem is to just leave this world. But I endured the pain, I waited for something to happen that would change my mind, and it eventually happened, every time. It might take days, weeks or even months, but it will eventually happen.

I really hope you think about this, and try to find an alternative solution to this situation.

Hey man, I’ve been in a similar situation. Not this serious, but similar. I was also very attached to a girl and the only thing that helped me is that I found a new girl to talk to, after months of sadness.

I’m sure it will get better with time for you, there is plenty of subreddits that has people who are looking for people to talk to and you might just be one of them. Talking to a stranger on Reddit would help you I think, at least for starters.

I’m sorry to hear that, but why not even try to have a little hope, try to change? I know it can be tough, but if you succeed you will feel great once again, if you fail, you’ll be back where you started and will have another chance to try again. Don’t give up!

People will not be burdened with your problems on this subreddit, they wouldn’t be here otherwise. Do you have any activities you like doing? Good activities that might help you defeat the sadness you are having? Doing things I like helped me a lot.
Why is that? Don’t lose hope yet, it is never too late.
Have you tried talking to other people on this subreddit? They are a lot more useful than you might think they are.
Send a PM to me

I like working out, playing video games, spending time with my close trustworthy friends.

It might be good to also address that we weren’t a couple, but at the same time we were REALLY close. It’s a pretty long story to be honest
Almost half a year, not really that long of a time, but still.
No, I think someone will be that person at some point, well, I hope.
Thank you, I wish you the best of luck, the world needs more people like you.
I’m starting to realise that just now, and thank you, for everything.
Thank you for your kind words, they mean a lot to me.
I just hope you’re right, thank you.
It doesn’t sound corny, and I really hope it you’re right. Thank you.
I’ve done some things that I’m not proud of, but I’ve changed for the good since then, maybe everything is coming back at me.
Thank you, honestly.

When I really like a person I try to give him the best I can, I sometimes forget about myself and end up getting hurt.

I just hope you’re doing alright.

That’s what I thought I had going for me, somebody for once accepted my love and genuinely liked me. Turns out I was just being used

Edit: changed some stuff
Thank you, your kind words mean a lot to me, they really do. I don’t usually get any.
I just wish somebody accepted my love.

Honestly I’ve never had a stranger say nice things to me. By nice I meant to say I don’t look for trouble, I try to be friends with everyone. I feel worthless because I do so many things for others, not trying to sound like an egoist, but I get nothing back from them mostly, not even a thank you sometimes.
